scheme_name: 50% concession on pending traffic e-challan fines (June–July 2026 drive)
note: Karnataka's latest 50% concession window closed on 10 July 2026. It was the state's sixth such drive — ₹96.73 lakh was collected on day one (32,486 cases settled) and over ₹18.15 crore in the first 14 days (6,06,032 cases). These drives recur but each needs a fresh government announcement, made through the press rather than a standing published order — no official order for any drive is available online — and there is no discount between windows.

history.summary: Karnataka ran two 50% concession drives in 2025; the August–September drive alone collected over ₹106 crore and settled more than 37.8 lakh pending cases in 22 days.
Three 50% concession drives on pending traffic fines were offered during 2023; the February window collected ₹5.61 crore across 2,01,828 cases in Bengaluru on its first day alone.
